display_name: F三路＋统一Sinc＋RDrop：频带更新目标clean三种子对照
description: Full-source scratch50 33L+17U. Fixed FULL historicalF/NORM/BAND x3seeds;6 new models,3 reused references. All 3seeds frozen now before any new target results; target performance is primary, source health only.
authorization: User20261016 requires comprehensive F optimization and performance on test target domain, not source comparison. Direct fixed full-source50 target matrix. Preserve all healthy jobs.

code.environment: ordinary N607 CVS-RFFI Python; CPU2 perworker, loader0, CUDAempty dispatcher/scorers

data.representation: raw received residual/post_sync/noeq IQ; fixed256 packet; deployed160-dimensional id_feat_joint

roles.L_s: 6300 original legal labels, 10% of train pool / 7% of all90000 source
roles.U_s: 56700 original hidden TX, native oldgate/ownEMA only
roles.V: 27000 source health/default-head diagnostics only, no training

data.capsule_id: existing VALIDATED_ONCE Phase1 capsule manifest; reuse unchanged
data.split_id: original registered source/target physical split; reuse unchanged
data.source_days_correction: Descriptive metadata corrected from [0,1,2] to actual native wisig_train_days/day_i [1,2,3]; same exact physical role IDs, no data or run change

permissions.query_use: Only fixedfinal rowwise prediction after legal source freeze; fresh CPU truth after full row prediction
permissions.L_s: 6300 original legal labels and original normal augmentation; no labels outside role
permissions.U_s: 56700 hidden TX, original oldgate/ownEMA/strong only, no new consistency or true labels
permissions.V: 27000 health and fixedsource gate, no gradients/EMA/state/fitted heads
permissions.claim_scope: Fixed exposed ManySig clean matched effects of X3/unifiedSinc on RDrop, not independent blind/newTX/Phase2/satellite.

checkpoint.initialization: New NORM/BAND scratch; FULL reuse immutable completed F final50 only for paired baseline
sources: AF r02 F-s2026092701/source/final_ssdg.pth (reference only; never new-model initialization)
AF r02 F-s2026092702/source/final_ssdg.pth (reference only; never new-model initialization)
AF r02 F-s2026092703/source/final_ssdg.pth (reference only; never new-model initialization)
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: new provenance.source_proof + original AF source_proof for FULL; same original physical source role_ids; no ancestor for new models
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Reused existing validated data/AF F provenance; minimal live evidence checked before loads
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixedfinal50; no target checkpoint selection or new seed selection

execution.gpu_policy: Five firstseed new rows ready; shared allowner <=3 processes/GPU including preCUDA startup and >=12000MiB free. Fixed10 remaining after source decision upload. No otherowner stop/restart/hotedit.
execution.stop_rule: Source/query legality, nonfinite, budget/role/path failures or missing legal predictions: preserve artifacts, stop new pending, keep healthy workers, no score-based stopping/retry.

metric_names: clean target defaulthead accuracy and MacroF1
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Eachrow prediction completion before fresh independent CPU truth read; FULL immutable predictions/scores reused
metrics_plan.interpretation: Target tests compare actual F optimization; source only verifies health/operation. All 3seeds preregistered before any new target summaries; all results retained and no feedback to remaining runs.

rows.purpose: Fixed target performance comparison; no source performance gate
